programmes.evidence: Current graduate catalogue explicitly names Mechanical Engineering PhD and Design and Manufacturing Systems concentration: understanding, analysis and optimization of design, production and operations in manufacturing systems and supply chains, with productivity, quality, reliability and sustainability remit. Requires original dissertation, proposal, qualifying examination and final defense. Exact programme page corroborates current doctoral Manufacturing & Systems Engineering research. This is one broad Mechanical PhD with a concentration, not a separate IE award.
limitations: No separately titled IE PhD invented. Southwest Research Institute collaboration retained without asserting separate degree-awarding institution.
